exitMessage: If you leave, the match will count as a defeat.

dialogs: If you can't find what you're looking for, try the back right.
No, I'm out of that.
Hey there, partner!
Only the best of the worst!
What you see is what there is, and what you don't see... doesn't exist.
Guaranteed quality! Well, guaranteed until you walk through that door.
No refunds, my religion forbids it.
That item has history. Most of its previous owners are no longer... available.
Haggling? Oh, how cute. No.
Ideal for adventurers eager to live... or with good life insurance.
If it shines, it's expensive. If it doesn't shine, it's 'rustic style' and it's also expensive.
Look with your eyes, buy with your gold.
It's not junk, it's... unclassified collector gear.
Looking for something that works or something you can afford?
Complaints accepted, but I don't guarantee I'll listen.
Careful with that, it's still hot. Literally.
Well! Another customer with expensive tastes and empty pockets.
Take it before I change my mind or it breaks.
I've got everything, except patience.
Come back when you have more gold... or less common sense.
Other adventurers once went down here. No idea what became of them...
I used to be an adventurer like you, until a slime sucked my knee.
You can buy everything you see, unless you're poor.
Free? I let you breathe without charging out of courtesy.
The first one to clear round 20 was some krm2707.
Not everyone is welcome in my shop, poor people can't come in.
You touch it, you take it.
I've got a pet called Guantes, it's probably hiding among the crates.
Where do I get so much merchandise? From those who don't make it past the round.
The doctor says I have silver poisoning.
lcaldon49 only comes to complain about prices.
My creator father is adrian.cutillas3. Say hi from me.
K0nexi0n is a professional at making the admin open bug reports.
Don't bet against K0nexi0n, the first one to ever win with `The Gambler`.
Come on, buy fast, tonight's casino night and the dice are hot.
